meta.title: Antaclis · Seeing through fields
meta.description: Antaclis builds AI for magnetic quantum sensing: simulation and machine learning that turn sensor readings into answers.
meta.image_alt: Antaclis logo and the words 'Seeing through fields.' next to magnetic field lines.

hero.title: Seeing through fields.
hero.lead: AI for magnetic quantum sensing. Simulation and machine learning that turn what a sensor reads into what produced it.

measure.title: Measure.
measure.text: A quantum magnetometer records the field, plane by plane.

infer.title: Infer.
infer.text: Simulation and machine learning trace the data back to its sources: where they are, how strong, which way they point.

landing.title: That is Antaclis.
landing.text: Custom AI for problems built around magnetic quantum sensors.

work.title: What we do
work.statement: Custom AI solutions for problems built around magnetic quantum sensors.

topics.title: Quantum sensors
topics.text: Quantum magnetometers, modelled down to their noise, drift and limits.

topics.title: Physics simulation
topics.text: Differentiable simulations of fields, sources and sensors, fast enough to run many thousands of times.

topics.title: Machine learning
topics.text: Models trained on simulated data and calibrated against real measurements.

topics.title: Inverse problems
topics.text: From readings back to causes, with uncertainties rather than a single best guess.
